Several of you have commented on the fact that these provide some nice ambiance, a much-needed touch of light and color to get through the long, cold winter months. You assume, it seems, that they are merely decorative. And I just want you to know that this is NOT THE CASE. I did NOT purchase these light strips, which are controllable via an app and capable of producing 16 million colors, because I wanted to set the mood. Instead, I wanted to convey the mood.
